VBO:0200455.summary: Deep-voiced and skilled at low-scenting, Dumfriesshire Black and Tan Foxhounds worked together in a distinctive Scottish hunting pack. Breeding emphasized physical strength, nose and voice. The old pack was dispersed to other hunts in 2002, while a later Dumfriesshire and Stewartry pack drew hounds from several other kennels.
VBO:0200455.shortDescription: Dumfriesshire hounds paired low-scenting skill with a deep cry, carrying a distinctive Scottish pack-hunting history.
